entries.title: Integrated B.Sc. and M.Sc. (BS–MS), Physics Major
entries.organization: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal (IISER Bhopal)
entries.details: Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462066, India

Experienced in first-principles modeling and data-driven materials discovery for catalysis, with a primary focus on density functional theory (DFT)-based investigations of electrocatalytic and photocatalytic systems. Research involves the design and analysis of single-atom catalysts, covalent organic frameworks, and low-dimensional materials, with emphasis on reaction energetics, electronic structure (PDOS, d-band center, orbital interactions), and reaction mechanisms. Proficient in integrating machine learning with high-throughput DFT calculations to accelerate catalyst screening and performance prediction. Extensive experience in high-performance computing (HPC) environments, large-scale simulations, workflow automation, and advanced data analysis for materials discovery.
DFT-driven catalytic materials discovery
Machine learning–accelerated catalyst design
Single-atom and low-dimensional catalytic systems
Electrocatalytic and photocatalytic reaction mechanisms
High-performance computing for large-scale simulations
